subject: Post-demo: context mix, token profile & budget check
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@retailify.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: context mix, token profile & budget check

Thanks for your time earlier, Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and a few concrete asks so we can give a tight pricing estimate.

Call recap (2/3 use cases):
- Conversational support (chatbot) for high-ticket returns: multi-turn, usually short prompts (20–80 tokens), completions typically 40–150 tokens.
- Catalog Q&A + product summarization: prompts 150–400 tokens (product + user query), completions 200–600 tokens.
- Batch enrichment (backend embedding + long context extraction): often need 32k windows for full product spec ingest, occasional 128k for full vendor docs.

Asks / next inputs we need from you:
1) Ballpark monthly token volume (prompt + completion) or ranges (low/expected/high) — helps choose tier and batching profile.
2) Average prompt tokens and average completion tokens per endpoint (or per use case above).
3) Percent of calls requiring >8k context (approx): 8k only, 32k, 128k.
4) Any SLA/throughput targets for peak periods (QPS).
5) If procurement wants a sample usage file, please attach the CSV you mentioned — will accelerate procurement/pricing.

Preliminary notes from our side: if ~6–8M tokens/month with a 70/30 prompt/completion split and ~10% of calls needing 32k, we usually recommend a mixed variant (base 8k model + auxiliary 32k nodes) to balance unit economics. I’ve attached a one-page sketch of pricing ranges (ballpark) — will refine once we get your token mix.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf (ballpark sheet)

Next step proposal: if you can send a token sample CSV + confirm budget band (eg $10k–$50k/mo) we’ll produce a precise proposal and schedule an ops deep-dive. Available times for a 45m ops call: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@retailify.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context mix, token profile & budget check

Thanks, Ava — good recap. Attaching the sample usage CSV we discussed (retailify_token_sample.csv). High level answers inline:

1) Monthly token volume (current pilot):
- Low: ~1.2M tokens/mo
- Expected (3–6mo): 6–8M tokens/mo
- High (scale scenario): 25–35M tokens/mo

2) Avg prompt / completion per use case:
- Conversational support: avg prompt 45 tokens, avg completion 110 tokens (heavy multi-turn but short).
- Catalog Q&A: avg prompt 320 tokens, avg completion 420 tokens.
- Batch enrichment jobs (async): prompts average 1,200 tokens, completions vary (we typically parse/extract so 300–800 tokens).

3) Context mix (rough):
- ~80% calls fit within 8k
- ~18% require 32k (product spec ingestion, longer catalogs)
- ~2% could require 128k for multi-vendor contract analysis but those are rare batch jobs

4) Throughput: conversational peak ~40 QPS for pilot, target 200 QPS in scale scenario. Batch jobs run overnight; latency OK in minutes for those.

5) Budget band: procurement indicated they can commit to a $25k–$60k/month range depending on unit pricing and TCO. Procurement loop: procurement@retailify.com (cc’d).

Let us know what you need next.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of AI Product | Retailify Inc
alex.morgan@retailify.com

Attachment: retailify_token_sample.csv
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@retailify.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@retailify.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context mix, token profile & budget check

Appreciate the quick data, Alex — very helpful. I skimmed the CSV (thanks) and sketched two concise unit-econ scenarios to make the budget band actionable. These are simplified; we’ll formalize in the proposal.

Scenario A — conservative (pilot): 8M tokens/mo total
- Mix: 70% conv (prompt+comp avg 155), 25% catalog Q&A (avg 740), 5% batch (long context)
- Approx token split: prompts 2.8M, completions 5.2M
- If we price at $0.95 per 1M tokens equivalent (example blended unit) cost ≈ $7.6k/mo

Scenario B — scale (committed): 30M tokens/mo total
- More batch + catalog usage increases avg token per call
- With batching/kv caching and a mixed 8k/32k deployment we can target $0.50–$0.70 per 1M tokens (depending on discount/commit) cost ≈ $15k–$21k/mo

Notes about context sizing:
- For the ~18% 32k use cases, we recommend routing those requests to dedicated 32k workers to avoid inflating 8k queue latencies. That means a small fraction of dedicated capacity but yields better tail latency.
- 128k needs appear to be occasional batch jobs; recommend asynchronous job flow to keep unit costs predictable.

Suggested next steps:
1) Redwood to draft a 1-page commercial (numbers for A and B) + technical deployment sketch (8k baseline + 32k pool + async 128k jobs). I’ll attach that PDF in the proposal.
2) Schedule a 45m ops call (we can deep-dive on routing, caching, and SLA). Proposed slots: Wed 9–11am or Thu 1–3pm PST.
3) Procurement: if the $25k–$60k/mo band looks viable, we’ll include committed pricing options and a 3-month runway discount.

Ben/Marissa — can you pick which slot to propose and own the ops call? I’ll prepare the draft commercial and bring the deployment sketch.

Thanks,
Ava
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf
